toxicities: 与酒精或阿片等抑制剂混用可能致命。
summary: 一种极为常见的苯二氮卓，更知名为 Xanax，常用于治疗焦虑和惊恐障碍。阿普唑仑作用短，主要抗焦虑，也具催眠属性。高剂量常见失忆与抑制下降。不要与其他抑制剂合用。
effectsSummary: Anxiety relief, sedation, muscle relaxation, amnesia, drowsiness, ataxia.
generalRisks: Drowsiness, dizziness, impaired coordination, memory impairment. Risk of dependence. Dangerous with other depressants.
longtermRisks: Regular use leads to dependence. Withdrawal can be severe including anxiety, insomnia, and seizures.
saferUse: 如果在线购买，实际成分可能与标识不同。
